scripts.worker:build: bun run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/trptools-frontend-wrangler.log wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-worker
scripts.worker:deploy: bun run test && bun run check && bun run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.prepare: svelte-kit sync && bun run messages || echo ''
scripts.check: svelte-kit sync && bun run messages && node scripts/check-api-errors.mjs && node scripts/check-spelling.mjs && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.check:watch: svelte-kit sync && bun run messages && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --watch
